dict.string: Muya reads and opens files from your Desktop when you browse or drop them into a workspace.
Muya reads and opens files from your Documents when you browse or drop them into a workspace.
Muya reads and opens files from your Downloads when you browse or drop them into a workspace.
Muya reads and opens files from removable volumes when a workspace lives on one.
Muya reads and opens files from network volumes when a workspace lives on one.
